# spoke_container_service (Resource)

Experimental container_service management lifecycle against mock-v5. Requires a known environment scope. Management settlement and runtime readiness are separate; no live service is qualified. Import preserves principal ownership. Deletion refuses protection and independent dependencies.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Experimental mock-v5 declaration. Readiness advances independently.
resource "spoke_container_service" "example" {
  management_key      = "example-container-service"
  name                = "example"
  deletion_protection = true
  registry_id         = "registry_id"
  repository          = "app/web"
  digest              = "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
  service_account_id  = "account_id"
  cpu_millis          = 500
  memory_mib          = 256
  configuration       = { LOG_LEVEL = "info" }
  secret_references   = { CREDENTIAL = "secret_reference_id" }
  required_bindings   = ["database"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `digest` (String) Immutable image identity. Build and upload occur outside Terraform.
- `management_key` (String) Stable, non-secret recovery key, unique per independently managed resource.
- `name` (String) Mutable display name; never an adoption key.
- `registry_id` (String) Exact registry ID in this environment.
- `repository` (String) Exact OCI repository path.
- `service_account_id` (String) Explicit runtime identity in this organization; no implicit grants.

### Optional

- `configuration` (Map of String) Non-secret configuration only. These strings are stored in Terraform state; use secret_references for secrets.
- `cpu_millis` (Number) Declared CPU limit in millicores.
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Refuse deletion while enabled. Dependent resources restrict deletion even when protection is disabled. Defaults to true except for grants.
- `memory_mib` (Number) Declared memory limit in MiB.
- `required_bindings` (Set of String) Required connection slot names. Bindings refer to the returned consumer ID, avoiding a dependency cycle.
- `secret_references` (Map of String) Configuration slot to exact secret-reference ID. Values are identifiers, never secret payloads.

### Read-Only

- `active_revision` (Number) Last active effective revision; failure does not imply rollback.
- `desired_revision` (Number) Observed desired declaration revision.
- `effective_revision` (Number) Observed effective configuration revision, including independent bindings and secret references.
- `endpoint` (String) Observed service URL without credentials.
- `id` (String) Canonical import identity: `organization_id/project_id/environment_id/resource_id`.
- `operation_id` (String) Original management operation identity.
- `owner_id` (String) Authenticated management principal. Import does not transfer ownership.
- `protocol` (String) Observed service protocol; SQL wire support does not imply PostgreSQL/MySQL compatibility.
- `readiness` (String) Controller observation: pending, ready or failed. Settled management does not imply readiness.
- `reason` (String) Safe controller reason code; never raw service error text.
- `resolved_version` (String) Observed external secret version; no secret value.
- `resource_id` (String) Opaque ID for references and explicit provider target assertions.
- `revision` (Number) Observed Platform revision used for mutation preconditions.
- `target_path` (String) Exact management target path, usable by explicit grants.
- `tls_state` (String) Observed managed TLS state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import spoke_container_service.example org_id/project_id/environment_id/resource_id
```
